title: Letting Limits by Unit Type: Resort Lodging Nights and Party Size
content:
Every Resort Lodging unit type is let within published limits on the length of the stay and on the size of the party. The fewest nights it is let for differs by the window the stay falls in: a standard minimum outside the peak and holiday windows, a peak minimum inside the peak window and a holiday minimum inside the holiday window. The most nights one reservation of the unit type may run for is its longest stay. The nightly rate covers the unit type's standard occupancy, the number of guests the rate covers; its maximum occupancy is the most guests the unit type sleeps; and each guest beyond the standard occupancy carries the unit type's extra person nightly charge.

| Unit type | Fewest nights, standard | Fewest nights, peak | Fewest nights, holiday | Longest stay (nights) | Standard occupancy | Maximum occupancy | Extra person nightly charge (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base Village Inn Room | 1 | 2 | 4 | 21 | 2 | 4 | 35.00 |
| Slopeside Studio | 2 | 3 | 5 | 28 | 2 | 4 | 35.00 |
| Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence | 2 | 3 | 5 | 28 | 4 | 4 | 45.00 |
| Slopeside Two-Bedroom Residence | 2 | 3 | 7 | 28 | 4 | 6 | 45.00 |
| Mountain Lodge Suite | 2 | 3 | 7 | 28 | 4 | 6 | 55.00 |
| Summit Penthouse Residence | 3 | 4 | 7 | 21 | 6 | 8 | 75.00 |
| Private Mountain Chalet | 4 | 5 | 7 | 21 | 8 | 12 | 95.00 |

### Points of judgement on the figures

The three minimums are separate figures, and the one that governs is the one published for the window in question; the Slopeside Studio, for instance, is let for as few as 2 nights outside both windows, 3 inside the peak window and 5 inside the holiday window. The standard occupancy and the maximum occupancy of a unit type may be the same figure, as they are for the Slopeside One-Bedroom Residence at 4 and 4, in which case no guest can be within the maximum and beyond the standard at once. Where they differ, as they do for the Private Mountain Chalet at 8 and 12, the extra person nightly charge of 95.00 USD is the figure published for each guest counted beyond the standard occupancy.
